name: card-select
prompt: A single playing card being lifted softly off a wooden card table, brief gentle paper flick, quiet and warm, no music.

name: card-deselect
prompt: A playing card being set back down gently onto a felt card table, soft muted paper tap, quiet and close, no music.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A short low dull wooden thunk with a soft muted buzz, like a gentle 'not allowed' signal in a quiet game hall, no music.

name: card-draw
prompt: A playing card sliding briskly off the top of a deck of cards, crisp paper swish, close and dry, no music.

name: card-draw-take
prompt: A playing card being plucked from a small pile of cards on a table, quick light paper snap, no music.

name: meld-fan
prompt: Three playing cards fanned down onto a polished wooden table in quick succession with a soft satisfying flourish, subtle warm shimmer, no music.

name: layoff-tap

name: card-discard

name: turn-chime

name: round-win

name: round-lose
prompt: A gentle descending wooden marimba phrase of three soft low notes, quiet sympathetic defeat, warm and subdued, no music.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: A bright sparkling glockenspiel chime with a shimmering ringing tail, small elegant triumph fanfare, no music.

name: ui-click
prompt: A short soft wooden button click, muted warm and dry, subtle interface press, no music.

name: ui-confirm
prompt: A gentle wooden tick with a subtle warm resonance, soft interface confirmation tap, no music.

name: deal-round
prompt: A dealer swiftly dealing a row of playing cards onto a felt table, several light rhythmic paper slaps in quick succession, warm and close, no music.

name: hint-shimmer

name: match-win
